test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 
 

 12
 51
 18
 
 

 &
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f9162a36d7db9f8b2b316acfe95723e40c0ed99fb5ba927c4d96b52cf640edb.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab28a1d14e8caa64767f4f7c16da960fc231d0058c9a00169c9578a36600dcdf.png] 

12 + 26 = 8 + 30

38 = 38 (LHS = RHS)

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34b42ee658bd7c7e4ca6fbedc1c6f7ab063630f66e7e1be2360a850729954612.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6e25f49594889c5aa24b71b2467a62c5dc0515a53e7f4eadf8738e05092cca4.png] 

51 + 12 = 13 + 50

63 = 63 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc64a41d074ff573bba1f5be224d2dccdb396ddd937dfd4960cba67f28a5a2dc.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19e12022f14509971287464b3b8f5a2ddf5c9ee08b4037c51add44a31a5c88a2.png] 

18 + 12 = ? + 23

30 - 23 = ?

**7 = ?**

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
